seatbelt.description: Seatbelt: K buckles up in cars; a buckled player cannot leave the vehicle and survives faster crashes.

ejectUnbelted.description: Thrown out without belt: A crash above this speed throws the driver through the windscreen.

cruise.description: Cruise control: Y holds the current speed as the vehicle's top speed until pressed again.

noShuffle.description: No seat shuffle: A passenger stays in their seat when the driver gets out.

noRadio.description: No vehicle radio: Vehicle radios stay off and the radio wheel does not open.

fakePlate.description: Fake plate item: Fits a random plate on a vehicle the player has the keys to; using it on the vehicle again puts the real plate back. Garages keep the real plate.

boatRope.description: Boat rope: On foot next to a boat near a mooring (Moorings tab), the player ties it so it cannot drift or be driven off, and unties it again.

crouch.description: Crouch: Left Ctrl toggles a crouched walk.

tackle.description: Tackle: G while sprinting knocks down the player right in front.

point.description: Point with finger: B points where the camera looks; everyone sees it. Ends when the player aims, falls or fights.

handsUp.description: Hands up: X raises the hands, also in a vehicle (no fighting, aiming or getting in while they are up); X again lowers them. Other scripts ask the client export IsHandsUp.

ragdoll.description: Fall over: While its key is held (set one in the Keybinds tab) on foot the player falls over and lies limp.

carry.description: Carry players: From the radial menu a player carries the nearest player over the shoulder. Downed or cuffed players are picked up at once, anyone else is asked first.

sit.description: Sit on objects: Chairs, benches and stools from the Seats tab get a Sit down prompt.

antiPeek.description: Block corner peeking: A player cannot shoot at what only the third person camera sees round a corner: firing stops while the gun barrel is behind cover.

binoculars.description: Binoculars item: Using binoculars opens a zoom camera.

fireworks.description: Firework items: Fireworks are placed on the ground and go off after 5 seconds.

notepad.description: Notepad item: Using the notepad writes a page that becomes a note item; using the note shows its text.

diveGear.description: Diving gear: Using diving_gear puts an air tank and a mask on (or takes them off); while worn the player breathes underwater until the tank is empty. diving_fill refills the tank.

diveAir.description: Air in a full tank: Seconds a player breathes underwater on one full tank. Air is spent only underwater and kept per character.

diveWearSeconds.description: Putting on / taking off: Seconds the animation takes.

diveFillSeconds.description: Refilling: Seconds refilling the tank with a diving_fill item takes.

afkMinutes.description: AFK kick: Players who do not move for this long are kicked (admins never). 0 turns it off.

noDispatch.description: No GTA police: No wanted level and no AI police, ambulance or fire trucks.

hideHud.description: Hide GTA HUD parts: Hides GTA's cash, ammo count, area, street and vehicle names (the ai-hud shows its own).

noEmergencySpawns.description: No GTA police and emergency vehicles: GTA spawns no police, ambulance, fire or army vehicles and no police, medic, guard or soldier NPCs anywhere. Vehicles and NPCs that scripts create are not affected.

emergencyAreas.description: Areas without parked vehicles: At police stations, hospitals, the prison and bases GTA parks no vehicles at all, so their car parks stay free for players.

radius.description: Size: Metres from the middle in every direction.

noAircraft.description: No GTA planes: No planes take off from or park at the airports and the army base, and no jets fly over the map.

noPoliceAudio.description: No police radio: GTA's police scanner voice and police sounds around the city are silent.

quietAmbience.description: Quiet city sounds: Mutes far away sirens, car alarms and the music GTA plays while flying.

noGarbageTrucks.description: No garbage trucks: GTA's garbage trucks that stop in the middle of the road do not drive around.

noIdleCam.description: No idle camera: The camera does not start circling round a player who stands still, on foot or as a passenger.

noStealth.description: No GTA stealth walk: Left Ctrl no longer starts GTA's sneaking walk, so it only crouches.

sprintIndoors.description: Sprint indoors: Players can sprint inside buildings too, not only outside.

noAutoHelmet.description: No automatic helmet: Getting on a motorbike or into an aircraft does not put a helmet on by itself.

keepProps.description: Hats stay on: Hats, glasses and helmets do not fall off when the player is hit or pushed.

noActionMode.description: No combat stance: After a punch or a shot the player walks normally again at once instead of staying in GTA's hunched combat walk.

noPistolWhip.description: No pistol whip: With a gun in hand the melee keys do nothing, so close up the player shoots instead of hitting with the gun.

noCoverPeek.description: No blind peeking from cover: A player in cover cannot lean out to look without aiming.

noCriticalHits.description: No one shot headshots: A headshot on a player does the same damage as a body shot.

noBunnyHop.description: No bunny hopping: A second jump within 5 seconds makes the player trip and fall.

noPickups.description: No GTA pickups: Weapons, ammo, armour, health and money that GTA drops (from dead NPCs, for example) cannot be picked up. Items come only from the inventory.

noVehicleRewards.description: No weapons from vehicles: Getting into a police car or another armed vehicle gives no weapon.

noMouseSteer.description: No mouse steering: Cars, bikes and boats cannot be steered with the mouse. Planes and helicopters still can.

noAirControl.description: No steering in the air: A car or bike in the air cannot be tilted or rolled with the keys, so a jump lands the way it took off.

breakDoors.description: Open hood and trunk break off: Driving with the hood or trunk open above the speed below, or with a damaged body, tears it off the car.

breakDoorsSpeed.description: Break off above: An open hood or trunk breaks off once the car goes faster than this.

npcMelee.description: Change NPC melee damage: Sets how hard NPCs hit players with fists, bats and knives. Off keeps GTA's own damage.

npcMeleeDamage.description: NPC melee damage: Percent of GTA's normal damage: 100 is unchanged, lower hits softer, higher hits harder.

pedDensity.description: Pedestrians: Walking people, in percent of GTA's normal amount. 0 empties the streets.

scenarioDensity.description: Scenario people: People sitting, working or standing at fixed places, in percent.

trafficDensity.description: Traffic: Moving AI vehicles, in percent.

parkedDensity.description: Parked cars: Cars parked along the streets, in percent.

shuffleKey.description: Seat swap key: O moves the driver to the front passenger seat and back (not while cuffed or buckled up).

vehiclePush.description: Push vehicles: Holding E and Shift next to a broken or empty vehicle without a driver pushes it; A and D turn its wheels.

pushEngineHealth.description: Pushable at engine health: A vehicle whose engine health is this or lower can be pushed (1000 = any vehicle). A vehicle out of fuel can always be pushed.

pushBlockedClasses.description: Vehicle classes nobody pushes: GTA vehicle class numbers: 13 cycles, 14 boats, 15 helicopters, 16 planes, 8 motorcycles.

flipVehicle.description: Flip vehicles: A vehicle lying on its side or roof gets a Flip the vehicle option; after a short wait it stands on its wheels again.

flipSeconds.description: Flipping takes: How long the player works on the vehicle before it is flipped.

rearRagdoll.description: Fall when leaving a fast vehicle: A passenger who leaves a rear seat of a moving vehicle keeps its speed and falls over.

rearRagdollSpeed.description: Falls above: The vehicle's speed from which leaving it knocks the player down (4 m/s is about 14 km/h).

noPassengerMass.description: Passengers add no weight: A full car drives the same as an empty one.

noDoubleClutch.description: No double clutch: Stops the gear trick that keeps a car in a low gear at full revs for extra speed.

maxDrivingStats.description: Full driving skill: Every character drives and does wheelies with GTA's full skill, so vehicles handle the same for everyone.

vehicleCam.description: Better vehicle camera: Aiming from a vehicle moves the camera in close; V only switches between first and third person (GTA's middle view is skipped).

ledgeGrab.description: Grab ledges: A player jumping at a wall grabs its edge and climbs up when it is in reach (roof to roof jumps).

armReach.description: Reach: Largest distance between the player and the wall.

topMin.description: Lowest ledge: Lowest edge height, measured from the player's middle.

topMax.description: Highest ledge: Highest edge height, measured from the player's middle.

minSpeed.description: Least forward speed: A player falling straight down grabs nothing; below this forward speed no grab starts.

velocityAssist.description: Speed boost: The player's speed is multiplied by this when grabbing (1 = unchanged).

upwardAssist.description: Lift: Upward speed added when grabbing.

startTimeoutMs.description: Grab start wait: When GTA's climb has not started after this long, the grab is given up.

climbTimeoutMs.description: Climb wait: Longest time a climb is followed.

failCooldownMs.description: Wait after a missed grab: Time before the next try after a grab that did not start.

climbCooldownMs.description: Wait after a climb: Time before the next grab after a climb.

unstuck.description: /unstuck command: Right after joining, a player stuck inside a building or under the map types /unstuck, waits through a long bar and is taken to the point below. Once per join.

unstuckMinutes.description: Usable for: Minutes after the character loads during which /unstuck works.

unstuckSeconds.description: Wait: How long the player waits before being taken out (300 s is 5 minutes). They can cancel and try again.

unstuckPoint.description: Where /unstuck takes players: An open street everyone knows.

blockVehicleAreas.description: No vehicles: GTA parks no cars and starts no vehicle scenes here; the ones standing there are removed (work sites, car parks).

radius.description: Size: Metres from the middle in every direction.

blockScenarioAreas.description: No people at fixed spots: GTA puts no standing, sitting or working people here (bank counters); walkers and script NPCs are not affected.

radius.description: Size: Metres from the middle in every direction.

noPedZones.description: No people at all: No GTA people here at all: while a player is within 100 m of the area nobody spawns and the people inside are removed once. Script NPCs are not affected.

radius.description: Size: Metres from the middle in every direction.

densityZones.description: Density zones: Inside the areas of the Density zones tab their own traffic and pedestrian amounts replace the ones above.

mapBlips.description: Map blips: Shows the blips of the Blips tab on the map.
